 New GTA VI Footage Looks So Stunning Fans Can’t Believe It
 By Jake November 11, 2026 
 GTA 6 
 Share 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Bluesky 
 Pinterest 
 Reddit 
 WhatsApp 
 Threads 
 Email 
 Copy Link 
 Just a week from release, it seems as if new glimpses at the world’s most anticipated game are a daily occurrence!
 Only In Dade, a popular social media account focussed on showing local news and the wild and wacky side of Miami-Dade County, posted a short in-game clip from Grand Theft Auto VI to their Instagram story on Wednesday night.
 Following an hour or so of speculation amongst GTA fans on social media regarding the authenticity of the clip, Rockstar Games confirmed the video was genuine, as they reposted the clip on their own Instagram story.
 What Does The Clip Show?
 The 20 second clip, featuring the track “Sexy Magic” by CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and Étienne de Crécy from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , first features a slow cruise down the sun-soaked streets of Vice City, filmed from the back seat of a car.
 As the camera cuts, the reverse is shown: a pedestrian on the street is filming the car as it slowly cruises down the road. However, a closer look reveals that, behind either phone camera, is actually protagonists Jason & Lucia (Jason in the rear of the car, and Lucia stood beside a tree).
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by ONLY in DADE (@onlyindade) 
 Incredible Detail
 Praising GTA VI’s graphics goes without saying at this point, but immediately noticeable is the incredible fidelity and NPC density in the clip (no doubt explaining the targeted 30FPS Rockstar announced yesterday ). Some of the vehicles featured are also those seen in real life during Rockstar’s marketing in Miami recently.
 What do you think of the new footage? Let us know down in the comment section below.
 In other Grand Theft Auto VI news, even more gameplay details, which we covered here , were made public today.
